articles.title: This alien planet never has sunrise or sunset. It may support life
articles.summary: A planet with one side permanently roasting and the other frozen in endless darkness might still have a chance of supporting life. Their laboratory model suggests these worlds may be more hospitable than previously thought, despite their extreme surface conditions.
